title: Inpatient Cost-Share Percentage on a Line Under Allowable Charge Review — Appeals and Grievances Decision Table
content:
**Appeals and Grievances — inpatient cost-share percentage on the line under review: decision table**

Applies to an Allowable Charge Review opened on a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line.

The cost-share percentage on the line under review follows the facility's network status recorded on the line under review and the inpatient schedule of the tier the stay is billed under: a non-network facility under a tier whose non-network inpatient basis takes a percentage of the allowed amount carries that tier's non-network inpatient percentage; a network facility under a tier whose network inpatient basis is the lesser of a daily charge and a percentage carries that tier's network inpatient percentage; any other carries no percentage.

The tier is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the stay is billed under; its inpatient bases and percentages are the figures in the TRICARE Select schedule. A non-network inpatient basis takes a percentage of the allowed amount when it is a percentage-of-allowed basis or a lesser-of basis comparing a daily charge with a percentage. "Non-network" covers a facility recorded as non-network, participating or nonparticipating.

| Facility recorded as | Tier's inpatient basis for that status | Cost-share percentage |
|---|---|---|
| non-network | percentage of the allowed amount | the tier's non-network inpatient percentage |
| non-network | lesser of a daily charge and a percentage | the tier's non-network inpatient percentage |
| non-network | daily charge with a minimum | none (0) |
| network | lesser of a daily charge and a percentage | the tier's network inpatient percentage |
| network | daily charge with a minimum, or a per-admission copayment | none (0) |

*Hypothetical:* a tier whose network inpatient basis is the lesser of a daily charge and 20 percent, and whose non-network basis is 25 percent of the allowed amount. A network facility carries 20 percent; a non-network facility carries 25 percent. Under a tier whose network basis is a daily charge with a minimum, a network facility carries no percentage.
